description: Figure 5 illustrates the average number of likes for headlines categorized by season. The horizontal axis represents different season groups—winter, spring, summer, and autumn—labeled sequentially from left to right, with no apparent scale. The vertical axis is labeled “Average likes,” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 600, with tick labels at intervals of 100. Four bars are displayed, one for each season. The winter bar is light blue and extends to approximately 450 likes. The spring bar is light blue and reaches approximately 510 likes. The summer bar is light blue and extends to approximately 570 likes. The autumn bar is light blue and reaches approximately 430 likes.  A small inset graph in the upper right corner shows a line graph with the same season categories on the x-axis and a y-axis labeled “Predicted Avg” ranging from 0 to 8.3, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The line graph shows predicted average likes for each season, with values of approximately 0.16 for winter, 0.08 for spring, 0.24 for summer, and 0.16 for autumn. The bars are arranged in the order of the seasons and are all the same color, with no visual emphasis on any particular bar.
